text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The daily reviewed the defence forces parade on February 24, Independence Day. It for the first time included armour and artillery units.

- The newspaper gave a summary of the president's speech held before the reception in the Estonia Concert Hall. The president called for everyone to participate in the process of building up an independent state and attacked bureaucratic officials and greedy politicians.
- It is not yet clear when Prime Minister Tiit Vaehi will formally resign. He may hand in a letter of resignation on February 25 or 26, according to an anonymous source.
- The security police destroyed a large alcohol smuggling ring and exposed a police official, who sold information to criminals.
- Two paper mills have completed their reconstruction and will reopen the production of white paper in Estonia.
